title.zh: 通过用户ID查询用户信息（旧版）
title.en:
Indicates whether the user is muted. Valid values:

*   true
*   false

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limits

The QPS limit for this API is 100 queries per second per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. You can call the API properly to avoid this issue. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live list-message-group-user-by-id --app-id VKL3000 --group-id AE35-0000-T95F --user-id-list de100a0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live ListMessageGroupUserById --region cn-hangzhou --UserIdList de100a0 --AppId VKL3000 --GroupId 'AE35-0000-T95F'
